C0247.title: Kang Piyao v. Baotou Xincheng Yizhuo Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. – Copyright Ownership and Infringement Dispute
C0247.summary: The plaintiff Kang Piyao authored the literary work Baotou Fu. The defendant Baotou Xincheng Yizhuo Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. reproduced an excerpt of the work without authorization on a waterscape wall in its real estate development, failing to credit the author or pay remuneration.
